name: watch-party
description: Cross-country watch party: find titles common to every member's regional subscriptions and watch them in sync.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @watch-party/shared && npm run build -w @watch-party/server && npm run build -w @watch-party/extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @watch-party/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @watch-party/shared && npm run dev -w @watch-party/server
